traps: No guidance: the release says forward-looking guidance will be given on the earnings call, so any revenue, margin or capex outlook is invented; the only guidance mentioned is the April 29, 2026 guidance used as a comparison point.

GAAP vs non-GAAP: non-GAAP excludes only the impact from investments in OpenAI; this quarter that was a net gain of $480 million ($0.07 per share), so non-GAAP EPS of $4.74 is below GAAP EPS of $4.81.
Growth rates by basis: GAAP net income rose 31% and GAAP EPS 32%, while non-GAAP net income rose 22% and non-GAAP EPS 23%; the prior year had OpenAI losses, which is why non-GAAP growth is lower.
Net income is $35.8 billion GAAP and $35.3 billion non-GAAP; the dollar amounts are close and easy to swap.
The $3.2 billion Anthropic gain is not an OpenAI item and is not excluded from non-GAAP; the $0.27 benefit is measured against April guidance, not the prior year.
Constant currency is a non-GAAP measure: revenue 18% reported vs 17% cc, Intelligent Cloud 32% vs 31%, More Personal Computing down 4% vs down 5%.
Three cloud numbers: Microsoft Cloud revenue $59.3 billion up 27% (spans segments), Intelligent Cloud segment $39.3 billion up 32%, Azure and other cloud services up 43% with no dollar figure given.

Quarter vs fiscal year: the release also reports fiscal 2026 results ($331.8 billion revenue, $155.2 billion operating income, $17.95 diluted EPS); revenue grew 18% in both periods, so the growth rate alone does not reveal the mix-up.
The CEO's Azure surpassing $100 billion refers to the fiscal year, and Microsoft 365 Copilot's over 30 million paid seats is a seat count, not revenue.
Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud grew 14% reported and 16% only when adjusted for a prior-year in-period revenue recognition benefit.

Capex appears only in the cash flows statement: additions to property and equipment were $35,802 million for the quarter and $115,948 million for the fiscal year; the quarterly figure is close to GAAP net income of $35,766 million, so both round to $35.8 billion.
Capital return is $10.2 billion per the release; summing cash flow statement repurchases and dividends paid gives $11,337 million, which is not the reported figure.
Units: tables are in millions except per share amounts; $90,007 million is $90.0 billion. Basic EPS is $4.82 and diluted EPS is $4.81.
